note: Helena-Lewis and Clark NF (Snowy Mountain Range) campground at 5,700 ft below Mt. Harlow in the Big Snowy Mountains, reached by ~22 mi of Crystal Lake Road from US-87 west of Lewistown; the road narrows to single lane in places and only the last 5.7 mi are paved. Hazard-tree removal left open mountain views. Trails to the Crystal Lake Loop and the ice caves; the lake is stocked with rainbow trout, good for canoeing, and may dry up by late July in drought years. --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run, first-come first-served (all H-LC NF campgrounds). Changed booking reservable true->false, fcfs some_sites->always (the group site is a separate rec.gov facility); added $20 (2026), 16-day limit, opens ~June 2 / closes late October. Confirmed 28 sites, 45-ft largest slot, vault toilets, no electric (hookups left). Potable water left unset: the page contradicts itself (current conditions: none, being tested).
